podcast.body: A man from Manchester was threatened with jail time for repeatedly playing Underworld's "Born Slippy" at 3 AM. Each time police were called, they confiscated his speakers, amps, and other electronics, but he continually replaced them, eventually being ordered to pay a 1500-pound fine. "A man from Manchester was threatened with jail time after he wouldn't stop playing underworlds born slippy on repeat at three in the morning."
